Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
9:21 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 7, Core i5 or Apple M-series chip. Screen and keyboard matter more than a gaming graphics card.

MacBook Air (M-series): Best battery and quiet, and great if you build for iPhone or want Unix tools. Usually near your budget only on sale or in an older AI, and 16 GB RAM is worth holding out for.
Windows thin-and-light (Ryzen 7 or Core i5/i7): Good all-rounder with more ports and easier upgrades. Look for 16 GB RAM, a 1080p IPS screen and a keyboard you like typing on.
Budget gaming laptop: Only worth it if you also need a graphics card for games or machine learning. It costs you weight, heat and battery.

Prices change often, so check today's listings before you buy. Do you want Windows, Mac or Linux?
